note.title: Identity and relationships with others
note.specFocus: Describing yourself and other people, families and different family structures, friendships, disagreements, reconciliation, and future relationships.
note.sourcePages: Original GCSE Spanish revision material; it is not an official AQA paper, mark scheme, or copied publisher content.
note.summary:
Identity and relationships with others

Key vocabulary
- la familia; los padres; el hermanastro/la hermanastra; llevarse bien/mal con; confiar en; apoyar; discutir; hacer las paces; fiel; cariñoso/a; generoso/a; de estatura media; el pelo rizado/liso

Key grammar
- Use ser for identity and character and estar for temporary states. Make adjectives agree. Contrast the preterite for completed actions with the imperfect for past habits and descriptions. Add opinions with porque/ya que and future or conditional verbs.

Exam tips
- Do not confuse me cae bien (I get on with) with me gusta. In listening and reading, check who is being described and watch for siempre, nunca and ya no.

questions.examTip: Translate sense units, not isolated words, and check tense and negatives before finalising each answer.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. I live with my parents and my older sister in a small flat.
2. Yesterday I argued with my brother about the tablet, but we made up.
3. Last year my parents moved and now my aunt lives nearer.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the passage and answer in English.

“Vivo con mis padres y mi hermana mayor en un piso pequeño. Ayer discutí con mi hermano por la tableta, pero hicimos las paces. El año pasado mis padres se mudaron y ahora mi tía vive más cerca.”

1. What is said in the first sentence?
2. What additional point appears in the second sentence?
3. Give the main idea of the final sentence.

questions.modelAnswer:
1. I get on well with my cousin because he is fun and very sincere.
2. My best friend is loyal, patient and always listens to me.
3. I cannot stand selfish people because they never help others.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the passage and answer in English.

“Me llevo bien con mi primo porque es divertido y muy sincero. Mi mejor amiga es leal, paciente y siempre me escucha. No soporto a las personas egoístas porque nunca ayudan a los demás.”

1. What is said in the first sentence?
2. What additional point appears in the second sentence?
3. Give the main idea of the final sentence.

“Mi padrastro cocina mejor que mi padre y me ayuda con los deberes. Durante mi infancia jugaba al ajedrez con mi abuela cada domingo. En el futuro me gustaría casarme y formar una familia numerosa.”
